本文介绍了AutoREC，这是一个开源Python平台，用于开发、训练和评估强化学习（RL）智能体，该智能体能够从电化学阻抗谱（EIS）数据中自动生成等效电路模型（ECM）。尽管ECM被广泛用于解释EIS测量结果，但其识别通常依赖于手动试错，需要领域专业知识并限制了可扩展性，特别是在自动驾驶实验室等自主实验流程中。在AutoREC中，ECM生成被表述为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中强化学习智能体基于当前状态、可用动作和所得模型的反馈，依次修改电路拓扑结构。该平台支持端到端工作流程，涵盖带可选阻抗表示的EIS预处理、智能体设置与训练、针对新测量的ECM生成以及基于可视化的评估。

arXiv:2604.27266v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper introduces AutoREC, an open-source Python platform for developing, training, and evaluating reinforcement learning (RL) agents that automatically generate equivalent circuit models (ECMs) from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) data. In AutoREC, ECM generation is formulated as a Markov decision process in which an RL agent sequentially modifies a circuit topology based on the current state, available actions, and feedback from the resulting model. arXiv:2604.23865v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：脑活动基础模型有望为计算神经科学开辟新前沿，通过模拟神经对复杂刺激的响应，实现跨任务和跨模态的建模。一个自然的后续问题是：这些模型能否被反向使用？我们能否从合成脑活动中恢复出刺激本身或其属性？我们在一个概念验证场景中使用TRIBEv2来研究这个问题。我们将脑模拟器与大型语言模型（LLMs）配对，后者根据效价、唤醒度和支配度等语言参数生成新闻标题。随后，我们利用基于仿真的推断方法学习从脑图到潜在刺激参数的概率映射。结果表明，这些参数可以从预测的脑图中被恢复出来，证明该模拟器的合成神经编码保留了关于受控刺激维度的信息。研究结果还表明，大型语言模型可以作为可控的刺激生成器。

arXiv:2604.23865v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Foundation models of brain activity promise a new frontier for in silico neuroscience by emulating neural responses to complex stimuli across tasks and modalities. A natural next step is to ask whether these models can also be used in reverse. Can we recover a stimulus or its properties from synthetic brain activity? We study this question in a proof-of-concept setting using TRIBEv2. We pair the brain emulator with large language models (LLMs) that generate news headlines from linguistic parameters such as valence, arousal, and dominance. We then use simulation-based inference to learn a probabilistic mapping from brain maps to latent stimulus parameters. arXiv:2604.23351v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Whether intermediate reasoning is computationally useful or merely explanatory depends on whether chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contain task-relevant information. 本文构建博弈论模型刻画了AI辅助时代代理人通过机械性努力操纵绩效的现象，证明只要评估保留足够的创造性成分，基于绩效的筛选机制仍可行，但一旦AI能力增强到挤出创造性努力，该机制将坍缩为无信息量的混同均衡。

当代理人利用易于测量、常规性的任务来夸大可观察的绩效结果，而不贡献真正的创新或专家判断时，便产生了绩效操纵。我们在一个博弈论模型中将这一现象形式化，模型中代理人在两个维度上分配努力：创造性努力是非常规的认知劳动，其回报与代理人的私人专业知识互补，是委托人所寻求的稀缺投入；机械性努力则是执行明确定义的、基于规则的任务，这些任务独立于专业知识而提升绩效，是一种被AI大量增强的商品化投入。我们证明了对称、单调纯策略均衡的存在性，并表明只要评估体系中保留足够多的创造性成分，基于绩效的筛选机制仍然可行；但当AI能力增长到足以挤出创造性努力时，该机制将坍缩为无信息量的混同均衡。通过比较……

arXiv:2604.22230v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Performance manipulation arises when agents exploit easily measurable, routine tasks to inflate observable outcomes without contributing genuine innovation or expert judgment. We formalize this phenomenon in a game-theoretic model in which agents allocate effort along two margins. Creative effort is non-routine cognitive labor whose return is complementary to the agent's private expertise; it is the scarce input that principals seek. Mechanistic effort is the execution of well-defined, rule-based tasks that raise performance independently of expertise, a commoditized input that AI heavily augments. We establish the existence of a symmetric, monotone pure-strategy equilibrium and show that performance-based screening remains viable so long as evaluations retain a sufficient creative component, but collapses into an uninformative pooling equilibrium once AI capability grows large enough to crowd out creative effort. item.description:
FG²-GDN：通过双重细粒度控制增强长上下文门控增量网络

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19021

提出FG²-GDN，通过将增量规则中的标量学习率替换为通道级向量，并进一步解耦键值缩放以独立控制擦除强度与写入强度，实现对长上下文线性注意力的双重细粒度控制。

线性注意力机制已成为softmax注意力的有前景的替代方案，在推理时具有线性时间复杂度。近期的研究进展，如Gated DeltaNet（GDN）和Kimi Delta Attention（KDA），已经证明增量规则（delta rule，一种在线梯度下降更新）相比简单的加性更新能够实现更优的联想记忆能力。虽然KDA将粗粒度的头级衰减门控细化为通道级衰减，但增量更新中的学习率 $\beta_t$ 仍然是一个标量，这限制了模型进行维度特定适应的能力。我们提出了FG²-GDN，它将标量 $\beta_t$ 替换为通道级向量，类似于从SGD到AdaGrad和Adam等逐坐标自适应优化器的转变。我们进一步提出FG²-GDN+，它解耦了键和值的缩放，实现了对擦除强度和写入强度的独立控制。在合成和真实世界的（实验中）……

arXiv:2604.19021v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Linear attention mechanisms have emerged as promising alternatives to softmax attention, offering linear-time complexity during inference. Recent advances such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) have demonstrated that the delta rule, an online gradient descent update, enables superior associative recall compared to simple additive updates. While KDA refined the coarse head-wise decay gate into channel-wise decay, the learning rate $\beta_t$ in the delta update remains a scalar, limiting the model's capacity for dimension-specific adaptation. We introduce FG$^2$-GDN, which replaces the scalar $\beta_t$ with a channel-wise vector analogous to the transition from SGD to per-coordinate adaptive optimizers such as AdaGrad and Adam. item.title: 本文将极大似然成对排序的协同扰动形式化为预算约束子集选择问题，提出自适应子集选择攻击（ASSA）这一可扩展搜索方法，并通过实验证明该排序方法对较小但协同的扰动会表现出显著的、依赖运行状态的敏感性。
item.description:
计算决策系统中极大似然成对排序的扰动敏感性

Perturbation Sensitivity of Maximum-Likelihood Pairwise Ranking in Computational Decision Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17805

本文将极大似然成对排序的协同扰动形式化为预算约束子集选择问题，提出自适应子集选择攻击（ASSA）这一可扩展搜索方法，并通过实验证明该排序方法对较小但协同的扰动会表现出显著的、依赖运行状态的敏感性。

极大似然成对排序是一种常见的计算机制，广泛应用于优先级排序、声誉估计以及基于比较的决策支持。尽管其应用广泛，但该估计器在比较数据发生结构性变化时的扰动敏感性仍未得到充分刻画。我们将这一问题作为应用数学与计算科学中的稳定性分析问题进行研究。我们将协同扰动形式化为成对观测数据上的预算约束子集选择问题，并提出了一种自适应子集选择攻击作为可扩展的搜索启发式方法，用于探测高影响的扰动集合。通过在合成偏好数据集和真实观测偏好数据集上的实验，我们表明基于极大似然估计的排序可能表现出显著的、依赖于运行状态的敏感性：相对较小但协同的扰动可能引起输出排序的有意义变化，而其响应特征在不同状态下各不相同。

arXiv:2604.17805v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Maximum-likelihood pairwise ranking is a com- mon computational mechanism for prioritization, reputation estimation, and comparison-driven decision support. Despite its broad use, the perturbation sensitivity of this estimator under structured changes in comparison data remains insufficiently characterized. We study this question as an applied-mathematics and computational-science problem in stability analysis. We for- mulate coordinated perturbation as a budgeted subset-selection problem over pairwise observations and introduce an Adaptive Subset Selection Attack (ASSA) as a scalable search heuristic for probing high-impact perturbation sets. item.title: REALM提出了一种完全无监督的方法，通过将观测标签建模为模型预测与随机猜测的加权混合，联合学习模型参数和每个标注者的专业能力值，从而实现从噪声标注中可靠地微调语言模型。
item.description:
REALM：基于专注意识的可靠语言模型噪声标注微调方法

REALM: Reliable Expertise-Aware Language Model Fine-Tuning from Noisy Annotations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17289

REALM提出了一种完全无监督的方法，通过将观测标签建模为模型预测与随机猜测的加权混合，联合学习模型参数和每个标注者的专业能力值，从而实现从噪声标注中可靠地微调语言模型。

大语言模型的监督微调依赖于人工标注数据，然而标注流程通常涉及专业水平参差不齐的众多众包标注者。标准做法通过多数投票或简单平均来聚合标签，丢弃了标注者的身份信息，导致模型将不可靠标注者的错误吸收进自身参数中。我们提出REALM，该方法在完全无监督的情况下联合学习模型参数和每个标注者的标量专业能力值，且仅需标注者身份信息。其核心思想是将每个观测到的标签建模为模型预测与均匀随机猜测之间的混合，权重由标注者被学到的专业能力决定。REALM适用于任何具有固定标签集的任务，并可通过学习到的专业能力矩阵扩展至多任务场景。在四个带有真实众包标注的文本分类数据集上，REALM在全部12个配置中均表现最佳。

arXiv:2604.17289v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of large language models relies on human-annotated data, yet annotation pipelines routinely involve multiple crowdworkers of heterogeneous expertise. Standard practice aggregates labels via majority vote or simple averaging, discarding annotator identity and causing the model to absorb the errors of unreliable annotators into its parameters. We propose REALM, which jointly learns the model parameters and a scalar expertise value for each annotator, entirely unsupervised and requiring nothing beyond annotator identity. The key idea is to model each observed label as a mixture between the model's prediction and a uniform random guess, weighted by the annotator's learned expertise. REALM applies to any task with a fixed label set, and extends to multiple tasks via a learned expertise matrix. On four text-classification datasets with \emph{real} crowdsourced annotations, REALM is the best method in all $12$ configu

item.title: MOONSHOT提出了一个通用灵活的框架，通过联合优化逐层重构误差和训练损失的二阶泰勒近似两个目标，将任何单目标剪枝方法扩展为多目标形式，并能扩展应用于十亿参数级的大模型。
item.description:
MOONSHOT：一个面向视觉模型与大语言模型的多目标剪枝框架

MOONSHOT : A Framework for Multi-Objective Pruning of Vision and Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13287

MOONSHOT提出了一个通用灵活的框架，通过联合优化逐层重构误差和训练损失的二阶泰勒近似两个目标，将任何单目标剪枝方法扩展为多目标形式，并能扩展应用于十亿参数级的大模型。

权重剪枝是压缩大型神经网络的常用技术。我们聚焦于具有挑战性的训练后一次性剪枝设置，即在不进行任何再训练的情况下压缩预训练模型。现有的一次性剪枝方法通常只优化单一目标，例如逐层重构损失或训练损失的二阶泰勒近似。我们强调，没有任何单一目标能够在所有架构和稀疏度水平上都始终保持最优效果。基于这一洞察，我们提出了MOONSHOT，一个通用且灵活的框架，它通过联合优化逐层重构误差和训练损失的二阶泰勒近似，将任何单目标剪枝方法扩展为多目标形式。MOONSHOT作为现有剪枝算法的包装器运行。为了在实现这种集成的同时保持对十亿参数级模型的可扩展性，我们提出了模型……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2604.13287v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Weight pruning is a common technique for compressing large neural networks. We focus on the challenging post-training one-shot setting, where a pre-trained model is compressed without any retraining. Existing one-shot pruning methods typically optimize a single objective, such as a layer-wise reconstruction loss or a second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. We highlight that neither objective alone is consistently the most effective across architectures and sparsity levels. Motivated by this insight, we propose MOONSHOT, a general and flexible framework that extends any single-objective pruning method into a multi-objective formulation by jointly optimizing both the layer-wise reconstruction error and second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. arXiv:2604.12431v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Organisations increasingly outsource privacy-sensitive data transformations to cloud providers, yet no practical mechanism lets the data owner verify that the contracted algorithm was faithfully executed. item.title: 提出了SynMulti数据集及统一的合成数据生成流水线，可自动生成无限量、带丰富监督信号的多模态视频数据，并结合基于VQA的微调策略提升多模态大语言模型的视频理解与推理能力。
item.description:
SynMulti：面向多模态视频理解的合成到真实学习

SynMulti: Synthetic-to-Real Learning for Multimodal Video Understanding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12335

提出了SynMulti数据集及统一的合成数据生成流水线，可自动生成无限量、带丰富监督信号的多模态视频数据，并结合基于VQA的微调策略提升多模态大语言模型的视频理解与推理能力。

训练用于视频理解的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）需要大规模标注数据，涵盖物体计数、问答和分割等多种任务。然而，在真实世界中收集和标注多模态视频数据成本高昂、速度缓慢，且在多样性和覆盖面上存在固有限制。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SynMulti数据集，以及一个统一的合成数据生成流水线，能够自动生成无限量的具有丰富且多样监督信号的多模态视频数据。我们的框架在单一流水线中支持多种任务格式，实现了跨任务的可扩展且一致的数据创建。为了进一步增强推理能力，我们引入了一种基于VQA的微调策略，训练模型回答关于视觉内容的结构化问题，而不是仅依赖字幕或简单指令。这种表述方式能够鼓励模型进行更深层次的推理。

arXiv:2604.12335v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose~\textbf{SynMulti} dataset, along with a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. 面向深度异常检测大型混合数据集的自动化间歇蒸馏过程仿真

arXiv:2604.09166v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) in chemical processes based on deep learning offers significant opportunities but requires large, diverse, and well-annotated training datasets that are rarely available from industrial operations. In a recent work, we introduced a large, fully annotated experimental dataset for batch distillation under normal and anomalous operating conditions. In the present study, we augment this dataset with a corresponding simulation dataset, creating a novel hybrid dataset. The simulation data is generated in an automated workflow with a novel Python-based process simulator that employs a tailored index-reduction strategy for the underlying differential-algebraic equations. Leveraging the rich metadata and structured anomaly annotations of the experimental database, experimental records are automatically translated into simulation scenarios. item.title: 提出EvoLen分词器，通过将进化分层与长度感知解码相结合，把进化信息直接融入DNA语言模型的分词过程，从而优先保留调控基序等功能性序列模式。
item.description:
EvoLen：面向DNA语言模型的进化引导分词方法

EvoLen: Evolution-Guided Tokenization for DNA Language Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08698

提出EvoLen分词器，通过将进化分层与长度感知解码相结合，把进化信息直接融入DNA语言模型的分词过程，从而优先保留调控基序等功能性序列模式。

分词（token）是DNA语言模型（DNALMs）中表征的基本单元，然而其设计仍未得到充分探索。与自然语言不同，DNA缺乏固有的分词边界或预定义的组合规则，这使得分词成为一个基础性的建模决策，而非自然给定的选择。虽然现有的方法（如字节对编码BPE）擅长捕捉反映人类语言规律的词元结构，但DNA是按照生物学功能和进化约束来组织的，而非遵循语言惯例。我们认为，DNA分词应当优先考虑功能性序列模式，例如调控基序（regulatory motifs）——即在进化约束下形成的、通常在物种间保守的短重复片段。我们通过EvoLen将进化信息直接融入分词过程，这是一种结合了进化分层（evolutionary stratification）与长度感知解码（length-aware decoding）的分词器，以更好地保留……

arXiv:2604.08698v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tokens serve as the basic units of representation in DNA language models (DNALMs), yet their design remains underexplored. Unlike natural language, DNA lacks inherent token boundaries or predefined compositional rules, making tokenization a fundamental modeling decision rather than a naturally specified one. While existing approaches like byte-pair encoding (BPE) excel at capturing token structures that reflect human-generated linguistic regularities, DNA is organized by biological function and evolutionary constraint rather than linguistic convention. We argue that DNA tokenization should prioritize functional sequence patterns like regulatory motifs-short, recurring segments under evolutionary constraint and typically preserved across species. 用于预测谱波浪模型整体波浪参数的算子学习

该研究提出将深度算子网络作为SWAN谱波浪模型的高效代理模型，学习连续算子以实现与网格离散化无关的整体波浪参数快速预测，从而降低耦合风暴潮模拟的计算成本。

波浪诱导强迫对平均水位和近岸流的影响通常通过剩余动量通量（也称为辐射应力）及其空间梯度来建模。准确的风暴潮预测需要环流模型与波浪模型的耦合，但数值波浪模型高昂的计算成本限制了其时间分辨率。在本工作中，我们探索了将深度算子网络作为近岸海浪数值模拟模型（SWAN）代理模型的概念验证应用。与依赖网格的代理模型不同，DeepONet学习潜在的连续算子，因此能够在实现与离散化无关的推理的同时提供高效的预测。所提出的代理模型通过两个具有可变边界波浪条件和风场的一维与二维稳态数值算例进行了评估。当应用于实际数值算例时……

Accurate storm surge prediction requires coupled circulation and wave models, but the high computational cost of numerical wave models limits their temporal resolution. Unlike grid-dependent surrogate models, DeepONets learn the underlying continuous operator, and thus, can provide highly efficient prediction while enabling discretization-invariant inference. item.title: 本文提出一种通过闭式对抗扰动表达式实现线性时间鲁棒多智能体强化学习方法，用于在GPS降级和欺骗下保障小型无人机系统的间隔安全，无需迭代内优化。

小型无人机系统在GPS降级和欺骗下基于鲁棒多智能体强化学习的间隔保障

arXiv:2603.28900v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）解决了小型无人机系统（sUAS）在GPS降级和欺骗情况下的鲁棒间隔保障问题。在合作监视中，每架飞机（或智能体）广播其基于GPS的位置；当这些位置广播被破坏时，整个观测到的空中交通状态变得不可靠。我们将这种状态观测破坏建模为智能体与对手之间的零和博弈：以概率R，对手扰动观测状态以最大程度地降低每个智能体的安全性能。我们推导出这种对抗性扰动的闭式表达式，完全绕过了对抗训练中的迭代内优化，并实现了在状态维度上的线性时间评估。我们证明该表达式以二阶精度近似了建模不确定性集上价值函数的精确最小化器。我们进一步限定了...

arXiv:2603.28900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We address robust separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) under GPS degradation and spoofing via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). In cooperative surveillance, each aircraft (or agent) broadcasts its GPS-derived position; when such position broadcasts are corrupted, the entire observed air traffic state becomes unreliable. We derive a closed-form expression for this adversarial perturbation, bypassing the iterative inner optimization of adversarial training entirely and enabling linear-time evaluation in the state dimension. arXiv:2603.28301v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by leveraging pre-trained vision-language backbones. However, in downstream robotic settings, they are typically fine-tuned with limited data, leading to overfitting to specific instruction formulations and leaving robustness to paraphrased instructions underexplored. PeopleSearchBench：基于标准锚定验证的AI驱动人物搜索平台评估

PeopleSearchBench: Evaluating AI-Powered People Search Platforms with Criteria-Grounded Verification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27476

该论文提出了首个用于评估AI人物搜索平台的开源基准PeopleSearchBench，其核心创新“标准锚定验证”方法通过将查询分解为可独立核查的标准并结合实时网络搜索验证，实现了客观、可复现的事实性评估。

AI驱动的人物搜索平台正日益被部署于招聘、销售线索挖掘和职业社交等场景，但目前尚无标准化基准可对其进行严格评估。我们提出了PeopleSearchBench，一个开源基准，包含119个多语言查询，涵盖四种场景：企业招聘、B2B销售线索挖掘、专家搜索和网红发现。其核心贡献是“标准锚定验证”，这是一种评估方法，将每个查询分解为明确且可独立核查的标准，并通过实时网络搜索对每个返回的候选人进行验证，从而产生基于事实的相关性判断，而非主观的LLM-as-judge评分（与人工标注者的一致性达Cohen's kappa = 0.84）。我们从三个互补维度——相关性精确率、有效覆盖率和信息效用——评估了四个架构各异的平台，并发现多源搜索智能体显著（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2603.27476v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI-powered people search platforms are increasingly deployed for recruiting, sales prospecting, and professional networking, yet no standardized benchmark exists for their rigorous evaluation. We present PeopleSearchBench, an open-source benchmark comprising 119 multilingual queries across four scenarios: corporate recruiting, B2B sales prospecting, expert search, and influencer discovery. A central contribution is Criteria-Grounded Verification, an evaluation methodology that decomposes each query into explicit, independently checkable criteria and verifies each returned individual via live web search, producing factual relevance judgments rather than subjective LLM-as-judge scores (Cohen's kappa = 0.84 with human annotators). arXiv:2603.26024v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：识别二元数值数据中的因果方向性是一个基础性研究问题，具有重要的实际应用意义。本文提出了两种通过考虑条件分布来识别因果方向的替代方法：（1）预期不对称几何（AAG）和（2）单调性指数（MI）。AAG方法将实际的条件分布与沿两个变量的预期分布进行比较，并评估了多种比较度量，如皮尔逊相关系数、余弦距离、杰卡德指数、K-L散度、K-S距离、平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方误差（MSE）和互信息。预期分布基于双重响应统计量（均值和标准差）被投影为正态分布。MI方法比较沿两个轴计算的条件分布梯度的单调性指数，并展示梯度符号变化的次数。两种方法均假设……的随机特性（原文在此处截断）。

This paper presents two alternative methods to identify direction of causation by considering conditional distributions: (1) Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries (AAG) and (2) Monotonicity Index (MI). The AAG method compares the actual conditional distributions to anticipated ones along two variables. Anticipated distributions have been projected as normal based on dual response statistics: mean and standard deviation. The MI method compares the calculated monotonicity indexes of the gradients of conditional distributions along two axes and exhibits counts of gradient sign changes. item.title: 本文提出Mixture-Greedy策略，并发现在多样性感知的多臂老虎机生成模型选择问题中，UCB探索奖励并非必要——去除UCB反而收敛更快、样本效率更高、性能更好。
item.description:
面向在线生成模型选择的混合贪心策略：在多样性感知的多臂老虎机中UCB是否必要？

Mixture-Greedy for Online Generative Model Selection: Is UCB Necessary in Diversity-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21716

本文提出Mixture-Greedy策略，并发现在多样性感知的多臂老虎机生成模型选择问题中，UCB探索奖励并非必要——去除UCB反而收敛更快、样本效率更高、性能更好。

在现代生成式AI中，如何在多个生成模型之间进行高效选择变得越来越重要，因为从次优模型中采样的代价很高。该问题可以被视为一个多臂老虎机（MAB）任务。在多样性感知的评估分数下，生成器的非退化混合可以优于任何单个模型，这使得该MAB设置与经典的最佳臂识别问题区别开来。先前的方法在混合目标中引入了置信上界（UCB）探索奖励。然而，在多个数据集和评估指标上，我们观察到UCB项始终会减慢收敛速度并降低样本效率。相比之下，一种简单的、不包含显式UCB类乐观主义的Mixture-Greedy（混合贪心）策略收敛更快，并取得了更好的性能，尤其是对于FID和Vendi这类广泛使用但难以构造紧致置信界的指标。我们提供了理论见解……

arXiv:2603.21716v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient selection among multiple generative models is increasingly important in modern generative AI, where sampling from suboptimal models is costly. This problem can be viewed as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) task. Under diversity-aware evaluation scores, a non-degenerate mixture of generators can outperform any individual model, distinguishing this MAB setting from classical best-arm identification. Prior approaches incorporate an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) exploration bonus into the mixture objective. However, across multiple datasets and evaluation metrics, we observe that the UCB term consistently slows convergence and reduces sample efficiency. In contrast, a simple Mixture-Greedy strategy without explicit UCB-type optimism converges faster and achieves even better performance, particularly for widely used metrics such as FID and Vendi where tight confidence bounds are difficult to construct. item.title: 提出 LA-VDM 算法，通过地标约束扩散和两阶段归一化加速向量扩散映射，能够从点云精确恢复平行移动并渐近收敛于连接拉普拉斯算子。
item.description:
基于地标加速向量扩散映射

Accelerate Vector Diffusion Maps by Landmarks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21247

提出 LA-VDM 算法，通过地标约束扩散和两阶段归一化加速向量扩散映射，能够从点云精确恢复平行移动并渐近收敛于连接拉普拉斯算子。

我们提出了一种地标约束算法 LA-VDM（Landmark Accelerated Vector Diffusion Maps，地标加速向量扩散映射），用于加速建立在图连接拉普拉斯算子（GCL）之上的向量扩散映射（VDM）框架，该框架能够捕捉复杂数据集中的成对连接关系。LA-VDM 引入了一种新颖的两阶段归一化方法，有效解决了数据集和地标集合中采样密度不均匀的问题。在具有标架丛结构的流形模型下，我们证明了可以通过地标约束扩散从点云中精确恢复平行移动，因此 LA-VDM 渐近收敛于连接拉普拉斯算子。通过在模拟数据集上的实验以及非局部图像去噪的应用，验证了 LA-VDM 的性能与准确性。

arXiv:2603.21247v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose a landmark-constrained algorithm, LA-VDM (Landmark Accelerated Vector Diffusion Maps), to accelerate the Vector Diffusion Maps (VDM) framework built upon the Graph Connection Laplacian (GCL), which captures pairwise connection relationships within complex datasets. LA-VDM introduces a novel two-stage normalization that effectively address nonuniform sampling densities in both the data and the landmark sets. Under a manifold model with the frame bundle structure, we show that we can accurately recover the parallel transport with landmark-constrained diffusion from a point cloud, and hence asymptotically LA-VDM converges to the connection Laplacian. The performance and accuracy of LA-VDM are demonstrated through experiments on simulated datasets and an application to nonlocal image denoising.

item.title: 该论文针对已知共同协方差矩阵的多维高斯混合模型，提出基于傅里叶协方差矩阵的谱方法进行模型阶数选择与分量均值估计，证明了区分 $k$ 分量与 $(k-1)$ 分量混合模型需要 $\Omega(\Delta^{-(4k-4)})$ 个样本的极小化极大下界，并给出了样本量为 $\Delta^{-(8k-8)}$ 阶的谱阈值oracle估计器、实用的奇异值比率估计器以及基于MUSIC型投影目标的分数初始化梯度下降均值估计方法。
item.description:
具有共同协方差矩阵的多维高斯混合模型的模型选择与参数估计

Model Selection and Parameter Estimation for Multidimensional Gaussian Mixture Models with a Common Covariance Matrix

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19657

该论文针对已知共同协方差矩阵的多维高斯混合模型，提出基于傅里叶协方差矩阵的谱方法进行模型阶数选择与分量均值估计，证明了区分 $k$ 分量与 $(k-1)$ 分量混合模型需要 $\Omega(\Delta^{-(4k-4)})$ 个样本的极小化极大下界，并给出了样本量为 $\Delta^{-(8k-8)}$ 阶的谱阈值oracle估计器、实用的奇异值比率估计器以及基于MUSIC型投影目标的分数初始化梯度下降均值估计方法。

我们研究了具有已知共同协方差矩阵的多维高斯混合模型的模型阶数选择与分量均值估计问题。利用经验特征函数测量，我们构造了傅里叶协方差矩阵，其总体对应矩阵的秩等于混合分量的数量。我们建立了一个极小化极大下界，表明将分离的 $k$ 分量混合模型与 $(k-1)$ 分量混合模型类别区分开来需要 $\Omega(\Delta^{-(4k-4)})$ 个样本。随后，我们开发了一个谱阈值oracle估计器，对于固定的 $k$，其充分样本量为 $\Delta^{-(8k-8)}$ 阶，并同时提出了一个实用的奇异值比率估计器。在给定模型阶数的情况下，我们通过在MUSIC型投影目标上采用分数初始化的梯度下降来估计分量均值。在显式的样本量条件下，合格的样本初始化位于经认证的吸引区域内。

arXiv:2603.19657v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study model-order selection and component-mean estimation for multidimensional Gaussian mixture models with a known common covariance matrix. Using empirical characteristic-function measurements, we construct Fourier covariance matrices whose population counterparts have rank equal to the number of mixture components. We establish a minimax lower bound showing that distinguishing a separated $k$-component mixture from the class of $(k-1)$-component mixtures requires $\Omega(\Delta^{-(4k-4)})$ samples. We then develop an oracle spectral-thresholding estimator with a sufficient sample size of order $\Delta^{-(8k-8)}$ for fixed $k$, together with a practical singular-value-ratio estimator. Given the model order, we estimate the component means by score-initialized gradient descent on a MUSIC-type projection objective. item.description:
基于可预测性的可解释AI文本检测：一项复现研究

Interpretable Predictability-Based AI Text Detection: A Replication Study

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15034

该研究复现并扩展了AuTexTification机器生成文本作者归属系统，通过引入更新的多语言模型和26个文体特征，发现单一共享多语言配置在英语和西班牙语上均能达到与语言特定基线相当或更优的性能。

本文复现并扩展了AuTexTification共享任务中用于机器生成文本作者归属的系统。由于数据划分、模型可用性和实现细节方面的差异，无法进行精确复现，我们将其记录为一个可复现性的案例研究。我们测试了更新的多语言语言模型（mDeBERTa-v3-base、Qwen、mGPT），并添加了26个文档级文体特征，通过消融实验、置换重要性和SHAP分析来评估特征的影响力。同一套共享配置被同时应用于英语和西班牙语的子任务1和子任务2。在三个随机种子上的平均结果显示，共享多语言配置的性能与语言特定基线相当或更优，其中在模型归属任务（子任务2）上的提升最为明显。额外添加的文体特征带来了小幅改进，其中以词汇多样性的贡献最为突出，但其贡献

arXiv:2603.15034v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper replicates and extends the system used in the AuTexTification shared task for authorship attribution of machine-generated texts. Exact replication was not possible because of differences in data splits, model availability, and implementation details, which we document as a case study in reproducibility. A single shared configuration was applied to both English and Spanish across Subtask 1 and Subtask 2. Averaged over three random seeds, the shared multilingual configuration performs comparably to or better than the language-specific baseline, with the clearest gains on model attribution (Subtask 2). item.title: 提出PA3多阶段对齐方法，通过思维链推理让模型在推理时自动回忆并应用相关业务策略，并引入基于Jaccard分数的策略召回奖励和幻觉惩罚用于GRPO训练，无需在上下文中包含完整业务策略即可遵循复杂业务规则，性能比基线提升16分。
item.description:
PA3：通过思维链实现策略感知的智能体对齐

PA3: Policy-Aware Agent Alignment through Chain-of-Thought

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14602

提出PA3多阶段对齐方法，通过思维链推理让模型在推理时自动回忆并应用相关业务策略，并引入基于Jaccard分数的策略召回奖励和幻觉惩罚用于GRPO训练，无需在上下文中包含完整业务策略即可遵循复杂业务规则，性能比基线提升16分。

由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的对话助手在工具使用任务上表现出色，但在遵循复杂的、业务特定的规则方面却存在困难。虽然模型能够对上下文中提供的业务规则进行推理，但为每个查询都包含所有策略会带来高延迟并浪费计算资源。此外，这些冗长的提示会导致上下文过长，由于“大海捞针”问题而损害整体性能。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种多阶段对齐方法，教会模型在推理时通过思维链推理回忆并应用相关的业务策略，而无需在上下文中包含完整的业务策略。此外，我们引入了一种基于Jaccard分数的新型策略召回奖励以及用于GRPO训练的幻觉惩罚。总体而言，我们的最佳模型比基线高出16分，并超越了规模相近的上下文内基线……

arXiv:2603.14602v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Conversational assistants powered by large language models (LLMs) excel at tool-use tasks but struggle with adhering to complex, business-specific rules. While models can reason over business rules provided in context, including all policies for every query introduces high latency and wastes compute. Furthermore, these lengthy prompts lead to long contexts, harming overall performance due to the 'needle-in-a-haystack' problem. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-stage alignment method that teaches models to recall and apply relevant business policies during chain-of-thought reasoning at inference time, without including the full business policy in-context. Furthermore, we introduce a novel Policy Recall reward based on the Jaccard score and a Hallucination Penalty for GRPO training. item.title: 该论文通过成员推断攻击系统地研究整流流模型的记忆行为，提出复杂度校准的度量方法将图像固有空间复杂度与真实记忆信号解耦，建立了首个专门针对整流流的非平凡成员推断攻击，攻击性能显著提升。
item.description:
整流流中的泛化与记忆

Generalization and Memorization in Rectified Flow

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13421

该论文通过成员推断攻击系统地研究整流流模型的记忆行为，提出复杂度校准的度量方法将图像固有空间复杂度与真实记忆信号解耦，建立了首个专门针对整流流的非平凡成员推断攻击，攻击性能显著提升。

基于流匹配目标的生成模型，特别是整流流，已成为高效、高保真图像合成的主导范式。然而，现有研究主要侧重于生成质量和架构扩展，而整流流模型记忆训练数据的内在动态机制在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。本文通过成员推断攻击（MIA）的测试统计量，系统地研究了整流流的记忆行为。我们逐步构建了三种测试统计量，最终提出了一种复杂度校准的度量方法，成功地将图像固有的空间复杂度与真实的记忆信号解耦。这种校准带来了显著的性能提升——攻击AUC最高提升15%，隐私关键的TPR@1%FPR指标最高提升45%——建立了首个专门针对整流流的非平凡MIA。利用这些改进的度量方法……

arXiv:2603.13421v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generative models based on the Flow Matching objective, particularly Rectified Flow, have emerged as a dominant paradigm for efficient, high-fidelity image synthesis. However, while existing research heavily prioritizes generation quality and architectural scaling, the underlying dynamics of how RF models memorize training data remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we systematically investigate the memorization behaviors of RF through the test statistics of Membership Inference Attacks (MIA). We progressively formulate three test statistics, culminating in a complexity-calibrated metric that successfully decouples intrinsic image spatial complexity from genuine memorization signals. This calibration yields a significant performance surge -- boosting attack AUC by up to 15% and the privacy-critical TPR@1%FPR metric by up to 45% -- establishing the first non-trivial MIA specifically tailored for RF. item.title: NanoVDR通过解耦文档索引与查询编码，使用冻结的2B参数VLM教师模型离线索引文档，并蒸馏出仅69M参数的纯文本学生模型来编码查询，在保持检索质量的同时大幅降低了推理延迟和GPU依赖。
item.description:
NanoVDR：将20亿参数视觉-语言检索器蒸馏为7000万参数纯文本编码器，用于视觉文档检索

NanoVDR: Distilling a 2B Vision-Language Retriever into a 70M Text-Only Encoder for Visual Document Retrieval

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12824

NanoVDR通过解耦文档索引与查询编码，使用冻结的2B参数VLM教师模型离线索引文档，并蒸馏出仅69M参数的纯文本学生模型来编码查询，在保持检索质量的同时大幅降低了推理延迟和GPU依赖。

基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的检索器已将视觉文档检索（VDR）的质量提升至令人瞩目的水平。然而，这类模型在文档索引和查询编码两个环节都需要同一个数十亿参数规模的编码器，即使是纯文本查询也会带来高延迟和对GPU的依赖。我们观察到这种设计存在不必要的对称性：文档在视觉上十分复杂，需要强大的视觉理解能力，而查询只是简短的文本字符串。NanoVDR利用了查询与文档之间的这种不对称性，将两条编码路径解耦：一个冻结的20亿参数VLM教师模型在离线阶段对文档进行索引，而一个经蒸馏得到的、仅6900万参数的纯文本学生模型则在推理时对查询进行编码。关键的设计选择在于蒸馏目标函数。通过在三个骨干网络和22个ViDoRe基准数据集上对六种蒸馏目标进行系统性比较，我们发现基于查询文本的逐点余弦对齐始终优于基于排序的方法。

arXiv:2603.12824v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-Language Model (VLM) based retrievers have advanced visual document retrieval (VDR) to impressive quality. They require the same multi-billion parameter encoder for both document indexing and query encoding, incurring high latency and GPU dependence even for plain-text queries. We observe that this design is unnecessarily symmetric: documents are visually complex and demand strong visual understanding, whereas queries are just short text strings. NanoVDR exploits this query--document asymmetry by decoupling the two encoding paths: a frozen 2B VLM teacher indexes documents offline, while a distilled text-only student as small as 69M parameters encodes queries at inference. The key design choice is the distillation objective. item.description:
波的语法：基于神经符号VLM智能体迈向可解释的多变量时间序列事件检测

Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11479

该论文提出了事件逻辑树（ELT）知识表示框架和神经符号VLM智能体框架SELA，使模型能够在极少或无标注数据的情况下，依据自然语言事件描述在多变量时间序列中定位语义事件，实现可解释的事件检测。

时间序列事件检测（TSED）旨在定位时间序列数据中具有语义意义的事件，在高风险领域具有关键应用。与统计异常不同，事件通常由具有内部时序逻辑结构的自然语言描述来定义，且这些结构跨越多个物理通道。然而，在现实场景中，密集的事件标注获取成本高昂，使得纯监督学习难以实现。我们提出了语言引导的时间序列事件检测（Language-guided TSED）这一新设定：模型被给定文本形式的事件描述，必须在极少或没有标注数据的情况下，将其接地到多变量信号中的相应时间区间上。为解决这一问题，我们提出了事件逻辑树（Event Logic Tree, ELT），这是一个知识表示框架，能够将语言描述转换为基于信号基元的结构化时序逻辑。在ELT的基础上，我们提出了SELA，一个神经符号VLM智能体框架，它从信号中迭代地接地基元……

arXiv:2603.11479v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Time Series Event Detection (TSED) aims to localize semantically meaningful events in time series data, with critical applications in high-stakes domains. Unlike statistical anomalies, events are often defined by natural-language descriptions with internal temporal-logic structures across multiple physical channels. However, in real-world settings, dense event annotations are expensive to obtain, making purely supervised learning difficult. We introduce Language-guided TSED, a setting where a model is given textual event descriptions and must ground them to intervals in multivariate signals with little or no labeled data. To address this problem, we propose Event Logic Tree (ELT), a knowledge representation framework that converts linguistic descriptions into structured temporal logic over signal primitives. Building on ELT, we present SELA, a neuro-symbolic VLM agent framework that iteratively grounds primitives from signal vi

item.title: 提出群体共振网络（GRN），通过可学习群体原型与基于PLV/相干性的多被试共振建模，将个体脑电动态与跨被试群体规律融合，从而显著提升跨被试EEG情绪识别性能。
item.description:
群体共振网络：面向脑电情绪识别的可学习原型与多被试共振

Group Resonance Network: Learnable Prototypes and Multi-Subject Resonance for EEG Emotion Recognition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11119

提出群体共振网络（GRN），通过可学习群体原型与基于PLV/相干性的多被试共振建模，将个体脑电动态与跨被试群体规律融合，从而显著提升跨被试EEG情绪识别性能。

由于严重的被试间差异，基于脑电图（EEG）的情绪识别在跨被试场景下仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要学习被试不变特征，但往往未能充分利用跨被试共享的刺激锁定群体规律。为解决这一问题，我们提出群体共振网络（GRN），将个体脑电动态与离线群体共振建模相结合。GRN包含三个组件：用于提取频段脑电特征的个体编码器、用于实现原型诱导共振的一组可学习群体原型，以及利用小规模参考集编码基于PLV/相干性同步性的多被试共振分支。共振感知融合模块将个体与群体级表示相结合用于最终分类。在SEED和DEAP数据集上，在被试依赖和留一被试两种实验协议下的实验表明，GRN始终优于竞争性基线方法。

arXiv:2603.11119v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging in cross-subject settings due to severe inter-subject variability. Existing methods mainly learn subject-invariant features, but often under-exploit stimulus-locked group regularities shared across subjects. To address this issue, we propose the Group Resonance Network (GRN), which integrates individual EEG dynamics with offline group resonance modeling. GRN contains three components: an individual encoder for band-wise EEG features, a set of learnable group prototypes for prototype-induced resonance, and a multi-subject resonance branch that encodes PLV/coherence-based synchrony with a small reference set. A resonance-aware fusion module combines individual and group-level representations for final classification. Experiments on SEED and DEAP under both subject-dependent and leave-one-subject-out protocols show that GRN consistently outperforms competitive ba

item.title: 提出个性化组相对策略优化（P-GRPO），通过基于偏好组特定的奖励历史而非即时批次统计进行优势归一化，解决了GRPO在异构偏好对齐中混淆不同用户奖励分布、偏向主导偏好而抑制少数信号的问题。
item.description:
面向异构偏好对齐的个性化组相对策略优化

Personalized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Heterogenous Preference Alignment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10009

提出个性化组相对策略优化（P-GRPO），通过基于偏好组特定的奖励历史而非即时批次统计进行优势归一化，解决了GRPO在异构偏好对齐中混淆不同用户奖励分布、偏向主导偏好而抑制少数信号的问题。

尽管大型语言模型（LLM）具备强大的通用能力，但由于标准的后训练方法（如基于人类反馈的强化学习RLHF）优化的是单一的全局目标，它们往往无法与多样化的个人偏好对齐。虽然组相对策略优化（GRPO）是一种被广泛采用的在线策略强化学习框架，但其基于组的归一化隐含地假设所有样本是可交换的，这在个性化场景中继承了这一局限性。该假设混淆了不同用户的奖励分布，并系统性地将学习偏向主导偏好，同时抑制少数群体的信号。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了个性化GRPO（P-GRPO），这是一种新颖的对齐框架，它将优势估计与即时批次统计解耦，通过针对偏好组特定的奖励历史而非当前批次统计进行优势归一化……

arXiv:2603.10009v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Despite their sophisticated general-purpose capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to align with diverse individual preferences because standard post-training methods, like Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), optimize for a single, global objective. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a widely adopted on-policy reinforcement learning framework, its group-based normalization implicitly assumes that all samples are exchangeable, inheriting this limitation in personalized settings. This assumption conflates distinct user reward distributions and systematically biases learning toward dominant preferences while suppressing minority signals. To address this, we introduce Personalized GRPO (P-GRPO), a novel alignment framework that decouples advantage estimation from immediate batch statistics. By normalizing advantages against preference-group-specific reward histories rather than the conc

item.title: 该论文提出一种将RKHS局部化与机器学习预测校正相结合的预测驱动条件推断框架，在标注数据稀缺、未标注数据充足的场景下，对条件均值等条件泛函构造出方差更低且始终有效的估计量与置信区间。
item.description:
基于预测的条件推断

Prediction-Powered Conditional Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05575

该论文提出一种将RKHS局部化与机器学习预测校正相结合的预测驱动条件推断框架，在标注数据稀缺、未标注数据充足的场景下，对条件均值等条件泛函构造出方差更低且始终有效的估计量与置信区间。

我们研究了预测驱动条件推断问题，其场景为：标注数据稀缺、未标注协变量充足，并且有一个黑箱机器学习预测器可用。目标是对在固定目标点处求值的条件泛函（例如条件均值）进行统计推断，且不对条件关系施加参数模型假设。我们的方法将局部化技术与基于预测的方差缩减相结合。首先，我们提出一种RKHS（再生核希尔伯特空间）局部化方法，从协变量中学习数据自适应的权重，并将目标点处的条件矩问题重新表述为加权后的无条件矩问题。其次，我们通过基于校正的分解将机器学习预测融入该局部化矩，从而得到预测驱动的估计量和置信区间：当预测器具有较强信息量时可以降低方差，同时无论预测器质量如何都能保持推断的有效性。

arXiv:2603.05575v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study prediction-powered conditional inference in the setting where labeled data are scarce, unlabeled covariates are abundant, and a black-box machine-learning predictor is available. The goal is to perform statistical inference on conditional functionals evaluated at a fixed target point, such as conditional means, without imposing a parametric model for the conditional relationship. Our approach combines localization with prediction-based variance reduction. First, we introduce an RKHS localization method that learns a data-adaptive weight from covariates and reformulates the target conditional moment at the target point as a weighted unconditional moment. Second, we incorporate machine-learning predictions through a correction-based decomposition of this localized moment, yielding a prediction-powered estimator and confidence interval that reduce variance when the predictor is informative while preserving validity regard

item.title: 该论文提出了开源、以运行（run）为中心的多模态安全评估平台 MUSE，将每次攻击运行的完整多模态多轮交互轨迹持久化保存，并结合五级响应分类体系（硬/软攻击成功率与灰色地带宽度），实现对大语言模型安全性的统一且细粒度的评估。
item.description:
MUSE：面向大语言模型多模态统一安全评估的以运行（Run）为中心的平台

MUSE: A Run-Centric Platform for Multimodal Unified Safety Evaluation of Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02482

该论文提出了开源、以运行（run）为中心的多模态安全评估平台 MUSE，将每次攻击运行的完整多模态多轮交互轨迹持久化保存，并结合五级响应分类体系（硬/软攻击成功率与灰色地带宽度），实现对大语言模型安全性的统一且细粒度的评估。

多模态大语言模型的安全评估不仅需要追踪攻击是否成功，还需要追踪交互如何跨越多轮对话和多种输入模态逐步展开。我们提出了 MUSE（Multimodal Unified Safety Evaluation，多模态统一安全评估），这是一个开源的、基于浏览器的、以运行为中心的多模态安全评估平台。MUSE 将每一次攻击运行作为执行、检查和分析的持久化单元，完整保存其配置、多轮交互轨迹、所传递的模态与媒体、目标模型的响应以及安全判定结果。一个五级响应分类体系进一步将完全遵从与部分遵从及拒绝行为区分开来，从而得出硬攻击成功率、软攻击成功率和灰色地带宽度（GZW）。在六个多模态大语言模型上开展的 11,700 次评估中，纯文本直接请求仅产生 3.1% 的宏观硬 ASR 和 4.4% 的软 ASR，而迭代式攻击流程则明显更为有效。攻击有效性也因……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2603.02482v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Safety evaluation of multimodal large language models requires tracking not only whether an attack succeeds, but also how the interaction unfolds across turns and input modalities. We present MUSE (Multimodal Unified Safety Evaluation), an open-source, browser-based, run-centric platform for multimodal safety evaluation. MUSE treats each attack run as the persistent unit of execution, inspection, and analysis, preserving its configuration, multi-turn trajectory, delivered modalities and media, target responses, and safety judgments. A five-level response taxonomy further distinguishes full Compliance from Partial Compliance and refusal behavior, yielding hard ASR, soft ASR, and gray-zone width (GZW). Across 11,700 evaluations on six multimodal LLMs, direct text-only requests yield only 3.1% macro hard ASR and 4.4% soft ASR, while iterative attack procedures are substantially more effective. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于变分自编码器与Transformer的参数化降阶模型高效再训练策略，仅利用稀疏观测数据和少量计算时间即可将模型实时自适应到新的流动工况，精度接近完全再训练。
item.description:
利用数据同化实现非定常流动降阶模型的高效实时自适应

Efficient Real-Time Adaptation of ROMs for Unsteady Flows Using Data Assimilation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23188

该论文提出一种基于变分自编码器与Transformer的参数化降阶模型高效再训练策略，仅利用稀疏观测数据和少量计算时间即可将模型实时自适应到新的流动工况，精度接近完全再训练。

我们提出了一种针对参数化降阶模型（ROM）的高效再训练策略，其精度可与完全再训练相媲美，同时仅需一小部分计算时间，且仅依赖于对全系统的稀疏观测。该架构采用编码-处理-解码结构：利用变分自编码器（VAE）进行降维，并利用Transformer网络演化潜在状态并建模动力学特性。该ROM由一个外部控制变量进行参数化（在Navier-Stokes设定中为雷诺数），Transformer借助注意力机制同时捕获时间依赖关系和参数效应。概率VAE支持对轨迹集合进行随机采样，并通过前两阶矩提供预测均值和不确定性量化。在有限的动力学状态集合上进行初始训练后，模型被自适应于分布外……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2602.23188v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an efficient retraining strategy for a parameterized Reduced Order Model (ROM) that attains accuracy comparable to full retraining while requiring only a fraction of the computational time and relying solely on sparse observations of the full system. The architecture employs an encode-process-decode structure: a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to perform dimensionality reduction, and a transformer network to evolve the latent states and model the dynamics. The ROM is parameterized by an external control variable, the Reynolds number in the Navier-Stokes setting, with the transformer exploiting attention mechanisms to capture both temporal dependencies and parameter effects. The probabilistic VAE enables stochastic sampling of trajectory ensembles, providing predictive means and uncertainty quantification through the first two moments. item.title: DesignAsCode提出将平面设计生成重新构想为基于HTML/CSS的程序化合成任务，通过包含语义规划器和视觉感知反思机制的“规划-实现-反思”流水线，同时实现高视觉保真度与细粒度的结构可编辑性。
item.description:
DesignAsCode：在平面设计生成中架起结构可编辑性与视觉保真度之间的桥梁

DesignAsCode: Bridging Structural Editability and Visual Fidelity in Graphic Design Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17690

DesignAsCode提出将平面设计生成重新构想为基于HTML/CSS的程序化合成任务，通过包含语义规划器和视觉感知反思机制的“规划-实现-反思”流水线，同时实现高视觉保真度与细粒度的结构可编辑性。

平面设计生成需要在高视觉保真度与细粒度结构可编辑性之间取得微妙的平衡。然而，现有方法通常分化为两种路线：不可编辑的光栅图像合成，或缺乏视觉内容的抽象布局生成。近来将这两种方法相结合的尝试试图弥合这一差距，但由于其表达能力有限的表示形式和开环特性，往往受到僵化的组合模式以及无法解决的视觉不协调问题（例如文字与背景冲突）的困扰。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DesignAsCode，这是一个新颖的框架，它将平面设计重新构想为使用HTML/CSS的程序化合成任务。具体而言，我们引入了“规划-实现-反思”流水线，其中包含一个用于构建动态、可变深度元素层次结构的语义规划器，以及一个通过优化代码来纠正渲染缺陷的视觉感知反思机制。大量的实验……

arXiv:2602.17690v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Graphic design generation demands a delicate balance between high visual fidelity and fine-grained structural editability. However, existing approaches typically bifurcate into either non-editable raster image synthesis or abstract layout generation devoid of visual content. Recent combinations of these two approaches attempt to bridge this gap but often suffer from rigid composition schemas and unresolvable visual dissonances (e.g., text-background conflicts) due to their inexpressive representation and open-loop nature. To address these challenges, we propose DesignAsCode, a novel framework that reimagines graphic design as a programmatic synthesis task using HTML/CSS. Specifically, we introduce a Plan-Implement-Reflect pipeline, incorporating a Semantic Planner to construct dynamic, variable-depth element hierarchies and a Visual-Aware Reflection mechanism that optimizes the code to rectify rendering artifacts. item.title: 该论文提出一个弱假设的部分识别框架，将AI（如大语言模型）从非结构化数据中生成的测量值用作弱影子变量，从而在非随机缺失（MNAR）数据下实现总体量的识别与推断。
item.description:
用于缺失数据识别与推断的AI生成测量值：一种弱影子变量方法

AI-Generated Measurements for Identification and Inference with Missing Data: A Weak Shadow Variable Approach

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16061

该论文提出一个弱假设的部分识别框架，将AI（如大语言模型）从非结构化数据中生成的测量值用作弱影子变量，从而在非随机缺失（MNAR）数据下实现总体量的识别与推断。

在商业和社会科学应用中，结果变量常常以依赖于未观测结果本身的方式缺失。例如在服务系统中，客户是否提交评分取决于他们本会给出的评分。这种非随机缺失（MNAR）机制使得在不强加关于观测过程的强假设的情况下，总体量难以识别。与此同时，丰富的非结构化数据（如客户交互历史）日益可得，并可以利用大语言模型（LLM）等工具将其构建为结构化测量值。在本工作中，我们开发了一个弱假设的部分识别框架，将此类测量值用作弱影子变量，其定义为：在给定真实结果和观测协变量的条件下，与缺失机制条件独立的、含有结果信息的代理变量。重要的是，这些测量值无需准确预测缺失的结果或……

arXiv:2602.16061v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Across business and social science applications, outcomes are often missing in ways that depend on the unobserved outcomes themselves. In service systems, for example, whether a customer submits a rating depends on the rating they would have provided. Such missing-not-at-random (MNAR) mechanisms make population quantities difficult to identify without strong assumptions on the observation process. Meanwhile, rich unstructured data, such as customer interaction histories, are increasingly available and can be used to construct structured measurements using tools such as large language models (LLMs). In this work, we develop an assumption-lean partial identification framework that uses such measurements as weak shadow variables, defined as outcome-informative proxies that are conditionally independent of missingness given the true outcome and observed covariates. item.title: 该论文提出了一种面向NISQ时代的混合量子图学习架构，通过边缘局部和量子比特高效的量子消息传递机制，将所需量子比特数从$Nn$降至$2n$，实现了在嘈杂量子硬件上的高效无监督图学习。
item.description:
面向NISQ时代的边缘局部与量子比特高效量子图学习

Edge-Local and Qubit-Efficient Quantum Graph Learning for the NISQ Era

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16018

该论文提出了一种面向NISQ时代的混合量子图学习架构，通过边缘局部和量子比特高效的量子消息传递机制，将所需量子比特数从$Nn$降至$2n$，实现了在嘈杂量子硬件上的高效无监督图学习。

arXiv:2602.16018v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：图神经网络（GNNs）是从图结构数据中学习表示的强大框架，但它们在近期量子硬件上的直接实现仍面临电路深度、多量子比特交互和量子比特可扩展性约束的挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种混合量子图学习架构，专门设计用于嘈杂中等规模量子（NISQ）机制下的无监督学习。我们的方法将变分量子特征提取层与受量子交替算子Ansatz（QAOA）框架启发的边缘局部且量子比特高效的量子消息传递机制相结合。消息传递操作通过标准单量子比特和双量子比特门沿图边缘分解为成对交互。对于具有$N$个节点和$n$量子比特特征寄存器的图，这减少了同时所需的量子比特数量，从$Nn$降至最多$2n$。我们进一步...

arXiv:2602.16018v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a powerful framework for learning representations from graph-structured data, but their direct implementation on near-term quantum hardware remains challenging due to circuit depth, multi-qubit interactions, and qubit scalability constraints. In this work, we introduce a hybrid quantum graph learning architecture designed explicitly for unsupervised learning in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime. Our approach combines a variational quantum feature extraction layer with an edge-local and qubit-efficient quantum message-passing mechanism inspired by the Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOA) framework. The message-passing operation is decomposed into pairwise interactions along graph edges using standard single- and two-qubit gates. item.title: 本文提出“反向n-wise输出测试”这一范式反转方法，通过直接在领域特定的输出等价类（如置信度校准分桶、决策边界、公平性分区、嵌入聚类等）上构建覆盖数组，以应对AI/ML和量子计算系统中因概率性输出和多路输出属性交互带来的测试难题。
item.description:
面向AI/ML与量子计算系统的反向N维组合输出导向测试

Reverse N-Wise Output-Oriented Testing for AI/ML and Quantum Computing Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14275

本文提出“反向n-wise输出测试”这一范式反转方法，通过直接在领域特定的输出等价类（如置信度校准分桶、决策边界、公平性分区、嵌入聚类等）上构建覆盖数组，以应对AI/ML和量子计算系统中因概率性输出和多路输出属性交互带来的测试难题。

人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）系统和新兴的量子计算软件带来了前所未有的测试挑战，其特征包括：高维/连续的输入空间、概率性/非确定性的输出分布、仅基于可观测预测行为和测量结果定义的行为正确性，以及信任性、公平性、校准性、鲁棒性、错误征候模式等关键质量维度——这些维度并非通过确定性的输入-输出映射来体现，而是通过语义上有意义的输出属性之间复杂的多路交互来呈现。本文提出了反向n-wise输出测试，这是一种具有严格数学基础的范式反转方法，直接在领域特定的输出等价类上构建覆盖数组，包括机器学习置信度校准分桶、决策边界区域、公平性分区、嵌入聚类、排序稳定性区间以及量子的（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2602.06859v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular patterns in graph data, and recent works have explored zero-shot generalist GAD to enable generalization to unseen graph datasets. item.description:
约束组相对策略优化

Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05863

本文提出约束GRPO（Constrained GRPO），一种基于拉格朗日方法的GRPO扩展用于约束策略优化，并揭示了在归一化前对标量化奖励会导致共享分母耦合，使改变一个约束乘子会同时影响奖励与其他约束的相对权重这一关键失败模式。

组相对策略优化（GRPO）仍然是大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）微调中占主导地位的无评论家（critic-free）方法，但其与约束策略优化（例如在安全关键领域）的兼容性尚未得到仔细研究。在本工作中，我们提出了约束GRPO（Constrained GRPO），这是一种基于拉格朗日方法的GRPO扩展，用于约束策略优化。我们证明，在归一化之前对标量化奖励这一标准做法会引入一种关键的拉格朗日特有的失败模式：GRPO的组内归一化使得约束优化对多组件学习信号的聚合方式高度敏感。我们进一步证明，在归一化之前对标量化奖励会引入共享分母耦合，使得改变某一个乘子不仅会改变其对应约束的受重视程度，还会改变奖励与其他约束之间的相对权重。我们通过一个简单但关键的修改来解决这一问题。

arXiv:2602.05863v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) remains the dominant critic-free approach for fine-tuning LLMs and VLMs, but its compatibility with constrained policy optimization (e.g. for safety-critical domains) has not been carefully examined. In this work, we introduce Constrained GRPO, a Lagrangian-based extension of GRPO for constrained policy optimization. We show that the standard practice of scalarizing rewards before normalization introduces a critical Lagrangian-specific failure mode: GRPO's within-group normalization makes constrained optimization highly sensitive to how multi-component learning signals are aggregated. 低秩适配方法已成为在计算与内存约束下将大型预训练模型适配到下游任务的关键技术。然而，这类方法面临一个根本性挑战：如何在任务特定性能提升与预训练知识的灾难性遗忘之间取得平衡，而现有方法对此给出的建议并不一致。本文对以权重矩阵主成分作为初始化的低秩适配中固有的性能-遗忘权衡进行了全面分析。我们的研究表明，与现有工作中使用前部主成分的PiSSA和使用末部主成分的MiLoRA相比，微调中间主成分能够带来更好的平衡性以及对高学习率的鲁棒性。基于这些发现，我们为LoRA方法的初始化提供了实用指南，以平衡性能与遗忘之间的权衡。在一项针对多种（任务/模型）的深入实证研究中……

arXiv:2602.03493v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) methods have emerged as crucial techniques for adapting large pre-trained models to downstream tasks under computational and memory constraints. However, they face a fundamental challenge in balancing task-specific performance gains against catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge, where existing methods provide inconsistent recommendations. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the performance-forgetting trade-offs inherent in low-rank adaptation using principal components of weight matrices as initialization. Our investigation reveals that fine-tuning intermediate components leads to better balance and robustness to high learning rates than first (PiSSA) and last (MiLoRA) components in existing work. 该论文提出LSTR框架，将稀疏转码器从事后诊断工具升级为潜在推理过程中可循环内干预的转移组件，通过Top-k稀疏特征使推理轨迹在机制上可检查、可因果干预，消融少量活跃特征即可使准确率下降高达16.5%。

潜在推理通过用连续的潜在状态转移替代显式的中间标记，降低了思维链推理的标记生成成本。然而，现有的潜在推理方法通常依赖于稠密且纠缠的转移，使其推理轨迹难以检查或干预。我们提出了LSTR（潜在稀疏转码器推理），该框架将稀疏转码器从事后诊断工具转变为潜在推理过程中可循环内、可干预的转移组件。在每个潜在步骤中，潜在转移转码器（LTT）将线性跳跃路径与Top-k稀疏创新路径相结合，暴露出一小组活跃的稀疏特征。在匹配的压缩设置下，LSTR为稠密潜在推理提供了一种机制上可检查的替代方案。在GSM8K-Aug数据集上，仅消融少数最活跃的稀疏特征就会使准确率下降高达16.5%，而类似的干预对稠密潜在推理的影响则要小得多……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2602.01695v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Latent reasoning reduces the token-generation cost of chain-of-thought reasoning by replacing explicit intermediate tokens with continuous latent transitions. However, existing latent reasoning methods usually rely on dense and entangled transitions, making their reasoning trajectories difficult to inspect or intervene on. We introduce LSTR (Latent Sparse Transcoder Reasoning), a framework that turns sparse transcoders from post-hoc diagnostic tools into in-loop, intervenable transition components for latent reasoning. At each latent step, a Latent Transition Transcoder (LTT) combines a linear skip path with a Top-k sparse innovation path, exposing a small set of active sparse features. Under matched compression settings, LSTR offers a mechanistically inspectable alternative to dense latent reasoning. 该论文发现领先的时间序列基础模型中间层存在普遍冗余，模型对整层消融具有鲁棒性，并通过将Transformer框架化为核回归器的理论框架，提出了基于注意力头投影稳定秩的纯内在消融策略。

时间序列基础模型利用大规模预训练，能够在推理阶段准确预测未见过的时序数据，而无需针对特定任务进行微调。通过在标准基准上进行大规模评估，我们发现领先的基于Transformer的TSFM在其中间层中存在冗余组件。我们引入了一套用于TSFM机制可解释性的工具，包括对特定组件的消融实验以及残差流上的直接logit归因。我们的发现在多个具有不同架构的领先TSFM上，以及在多样化的真实世界和合成时序数据集上均保持一致。我们发现研究中所有模型对整层消融都具有鲁棒性。此外，我们开发了一个将Transformer框架化为核回归器的理论框架，并由此提出了一种基于每个注意力头投影矩阵稳定秩的、纯内在的注意力头消融策略。

item.description:
基于伪标签的半监督CAPP Transformer学习

Semi-supervised CAPP Transformer Learning via Pseudo-labeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01419

提出一种基于伪标签的半监督学习方法，利用预言机从未标注零件中筛选正确预测并进行一次性重训练，无需人工标注即可提升CAPP Transformer模型在数据稀缺制造环境中的准确率。

高层计算机辅助工艺规划（CAPP）根据零件规格生成制造工艺方案。该领域在工业中面临数据集可用性有限的问题，降低了模型的泛化能力。我们提出了一种半监督学习方法，无需人工标注即可改进基于Transformer的CAPP模型。一个在现有Transformer行为数据上训练的预言机（oracle）从未见过的零件中筛选出正确的预测结果，随后将其用于一次性重训练。在具有覆盖完整数据分布的模拟真实标签的小规模数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比基线模型获得了一致的准确率提升，证明了该方法在数据稀缺的制造环境中的有效性。

arXiv:2602.01419v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-level Computer-Aided Process Planning (CAPP) generates manufacturing process plans from part specifications. It suffers from limited dataset availability in industry, reducing model generalization. We propose a semi-supervised learning approach to improve transformer-based CAPP transformer models without manual labeling. An oracle, trained on available transformer behaviour data, filters correct predictions from unseen parts, which are then used for one-shot retraining. Experiments on small-scale datasets with simulated ground truth across the full data distribution show consistent accuracy gains over baselines, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in data-scarce manufacturing environments.

分布式物联网设备间的时间完整性是能源信息物理系统中实现可靠感知、控制与安全的基础。然而，实际运行的能源物联网系统仍然容易受到时钟漂移加剧、时间同步操纵以及灾难性时间戳不连续（例如2038年问题（Y2K38）Unix纪元溢出）等威胁的影响。这些故障会破坏时间戳的单调性，扭曲时间顺序，并在系统观测数据中引入结构化的不一致性。传统异常检测模型通常假设时间戳可靠且顺序一致，因此难以捕捉时间层面的故障。本文提出了STGAT（时空图注意力网络），这是一种感知时钟动态的异常检测解决方案，能够在能源物联网系统中联合建模时间失真与设备间一致性。STGAT集成了漂移感知的时间嵌入……

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21670

该论文提出了一种轻量级即插即用的几何正则化框架，通过有界一致性原则在保留模态特定多样性的同时，仅软性约束超出可接受范围的跨模态漂移，从而同时提升单模态鲁棒性与多模态融合效果。

多模态融合通常被视为一个优化平衡问题，即通过调整训练信号来防止某一模态主导其他模态。然而，平衡优化并不能完全决定中间表示的几何结构。有监督的多模态模型仍可能学习到低多样性的模态特定嵌入，或使成对的跨模态观测过度漂移分离，从而同时削弱单模态的鲁棒性和多模态融合的效果。我们提出了\regName，一个用于多模态表示学习的轻量级即插即用几何正则化框架。\regName并不强制执行刚性的跨模态对齐，而是遵循有界一致性原则：在保留模态特定多样性的同时，仅对超出可接受一致性范围的成对跨模态漂移部分进行软性约束。在具体实现上，\regName结合了一个缓解谱集中的分散项……

arXiv:2601.21670v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multimodal fusion is often treated as an optimization-balancing problem, where training signals are adjusted to prevent one modality from dominating the others. However, balanced optimization does not fully determine the geometry of intermediate representations. Supervised multimodal models may still learn low-diversity modality-specific embeddings or allow paired cross-modal observations to drift excessively apart, weakening both unimodal robustness and multimodal fusion. We introduce \regName, a lightweight plug-and-play geometric regularization framework for multimodal representation learning. Rather than enforcing rigid cross-modal alignment, \regName follows a bounded-agreement principle: preserve modality-specific diversity while softly constraining only the portion of paired cross-modal drift that exceeds an admissible agreement band. Operationally, \regName combines a dispersion term that mitigates spectral concentrat

item.title: 本文提出了基于社会科学的十类LLM隐藏意图分类体系，证明这种隐蔽操纵行为极易被诱发且普遍存在于已部署模型中，并对现有检测方法为何失效进行了首次系统性分析。
item.description:
未知的未知：大语言模型中的隐藏意图能否逃过检测？

Unknown Unknowns: Do Hidden Intentions in LLMs Evade Detection?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18552

本文提出了基于社会科学的十类LLM隐藏意图分类体系，证明这种隐蔽操纵行为极易被诱发且普遍存在于已部署模型中，并对现有检测方法为何失效进行了首次系统性分析。

大语言模型（LLM）扩展了信息的可及性，为用户提供了广泛的信息获取渠道。然而，这些交互也为嵌入微妙的、目标导向的行为创造了机会，这些行为会影响用户的想法和行为方式——这一担忧也体现在禁止操纵性AI的治理框架中。我们将这类行为称为隐藏意图：嵌入在模型输出中的隐蔽议程，能够操纵用户的信念和行为。在这项工作中，我们研究了隐藏意图能否被识别和刻画，并评估了检测能否作为一种缓解策略。为了实现这一目标，我们引入了一套基于社会科学的十类隐藏意图分类体系，并证明这些意图极易被诱发。一项案例研究进一步证实，所有十类意图都存在于已部署的大语言模型中。随后，我们在这些类别上评估了静态分类器和LLM裁判，首次系统分析了隐藏意图难以被检测的原因。

arXiv:2601.18552v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLMs expand accessibility and provide wide-reaching access to information. Yet these interactions also create opportunities to embed subtle, goal-oriented behaviours that shape what users think and how they behave, a concern reflected in governance frameworks that prohibit manipulative AI. We refer to these behaviours as hidden intentions: covert agendas embedded in a model's outputs that can manipulate users' beliefs and actions. In this work, we examine whether hidden intentions can be identified and characterised, and assess whether detection can serve as a mitigation strategy. To operationalise this, we introduce a social-science-grounded set of ten hidden intention categories and show that they are trivially inducible. A case study further confirms that all ten categories manifest in deployed LLMs. We then evaluate static classifiers and LLM judges on these categories, providing the first systematic analysis of why hidden intent

item.title: 本教程展示了如何利用可微编程框架（如PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX）通过端到端训练来学习和设计一阶优化方法（如ADMM和原始-对偶混合梯度法），从而提升收敛性和解的质量。
item.description:
通过可微编程学习优化

Learning to Optimize by Differentiable Programming

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16510

本教程展示了如何利用可微编程框架（如PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX）通过端到端训练来学习和设计一阶优化方法（如ADMM和原始-对偶混合梯度法），从而提升收敛性和解的质量。

求解大规模优化问题需要具有低单次迭代成本的可扩展一阶方法。本教程重点介绍了优化领域的一个转变：使用可微编程不仅用于执行算法，还用于学习如何设计算法。PyTorch、TensorFlow 和 JAX 等现代框架通过高效的自动微分实现了这一范式。将一阶方法嵌入这些系统中可以实现端到端训练，从而提升收敛性和解的质量。在 Fenchel-Rockafellar 对偶理论的指导下，本教程通过代表性案例研究展示了如何学习和调整对偶信息引导的迭代方案，例如交替方向乘子法（ADMM）和原始-对偶混合梯度法（PDHG）。

arXiv:2601.16510v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Solving massive-scale optimization problems requires scalable first-order methods with low per-iteration cost. This tutorial highlights a shift in optimization: using differentiable programming not only to execute algorithms but to learn how to design them. Modern frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX enable this paradigm through efficient automatic differentiation. Embedding first-order methods within these systems allows end-to-end training that improves convergence and solution quality. Guided by Fenchel-Rockafellar duality, the tutorial demonstrates how duality-informed iterative schemes such as the alternating direction method of multipliers, and the primal-dual hybrid gradient can be learned and adapted through representative case studies.

item.title: 该研究发现，将自回归语言模型后训练为掩码扩散模型时会发生依赖任务的机制转变：在前缀主导任务上模型基本保留继承的自回归计算通路，而在全局约束任务上计算会显著重组并前移至更早的层。
item.description:
从自回归到掩码扩散语言模型后训练过程中的机制转变

Mechanism Shift During Post-training from Autoregressive to Masked Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14758

该研究发现，将自回归语言模型后训练为掩码扩散模型时会发生依赖任务的机制转变：在前缀主导任务上模型基本保留继承的自回归计算通路，而在全局约束任务上计算会显著重组并前移至更早的层。

将预训练的自回归模型（ARM）后训练为掩码扩散模型（MDM）为扩散语言建模提供了一条高效路径，但目前尚不清楚由此得到的模型是复用继承下来的自回归计算，还是将其重组以实现非自回归生成。我们在四个受控诊断任务上比较了两个 7B 规模的 ARM-MDM 模型家族，发现存在一种依赖于任务的机制转变。在前缀主导型任务上，MDM 基本保留了继承的高归因通路，或仅在计算发生的位置上表现出适度变化。在全局约束型任务上，重组则显著更强，任务相关计算向更早的层转移。这种沿深度分布的模式在提示重采样、电路预算以及所测试的推理预算下均持续存在，同时针对性消融实验在所测试的干预协议下支持了所识别结构的功能重要性。

arXiv:2601.14758v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Post-training pretrained autoregressive models (ARMs) into masked diffusion models (MDMs) provides an efficient route to diffusion language modeling, but it remains unclear whether the resulting models reuse inherited autoregressive computation or reorganize it for non-autoregressive generation. We compare two 7B ARM-MDM families across four controlled diagnostic tasks and find a task-dependent mechanism shift. On prefix-dominant tasks, MDMs largely preserve inherited high-attribution pathways or exhibit only modest changes in where computation occurs. On globally constrained tasks, the reorganization is substantially stronger, with task-relevant computation shifting toward earlier layers. This depth-wise pattern persists across prompt resampling, circuit budgets, and tested inference budgets, while targeted ablations support the functional importance of the identified structures under the tested intervention protocols. item.title: 本文提出了基于互动理论的SOCIAL CAPTION评估框架，从社会推断、整体社会分析和定向社会分析三个维度衡量多模态大语言模型的社会理解能力，并通过MLLM评判实验展示了自动化评估规模化扩展的路径。
item.description:
Social Caption：评估多模态模型中的社会理解能力

Social Caption: Evaluating Social Understanding in Multimodal Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14569

本文提出了基于互动理论的SOCIAL CAPTION评估框架，从社会推断、整体社会分析和定向社会分析三个维度衡量多模态大语言模型的社会理解能力，并通过MLLM评判实验展示了自动化评估规模化扩展的路径。

社会理解能力对于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）解读人类社会互动至关重要。我们提出了SOCIAL CAPTION，这是一个基于互动理论的框架，用于从三个维度评估MLLM的社会理解能力：社会推断，即对互动做出准确推断的能力；整体社会分析，即对互动生成全面描述的能力；定向社会分析，即从互动中提取相关信息的能力。我们分析了影响模型社会理解表现的因素，例如模型规模、架构设计和口语语境。使用MLLM作为评判者的实验展示了扩展多模态社会理解自动化评估的可行路径。

arXiv:2601.14569v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Social understanding abilities are crucial for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret human social interactions. We introduce SOCIAL CAPTION, a framework grounded in interaction theory to evaluate social understanding abilities of MLLMs along three dimensions: Social Inference (SI), the ability to make accurate inferences about interactions; Holistic Social Analysis (HSA), the ability to generate comprehensive descriptions of interactions; Directed Social Analysis (DSA), the ability to generate relevant information from interactions. We analyze factors influencing model performance in social understanding, such as scale, architectural design, and spoken context. Experiments with MLLM judges demonstrate a path towards scaling automated evaluation of multimodal social understanding.

item.title: 该论文通过探测、神经元级归因和针对性干预等可解释性方法，机制性地揭示了种族和民族线索在大语言模型内部的表征与运用方式，发现对人口统计线索的敏感性广泛分布于多个内部单元且在不同模型间差异显著。
item.description:
追溯潜在线索：大语言模型如何表征与运用种族和民族线索的机制研究

Tracing the Latent Threads: A Mechanistic Study of How LLMs Represent and Operationalize Race and Ethnicity Cues

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12868

该论文通过探测、神经元级归因和针对性干预等可解释性方法，机制性地揭示了种族和民族线索在大语言模型内部的表征与运用方式，发现对人口统计线索的敏感性广泛分布于多个内部单元且在不同模型间差异显著。

arXiv:2601.12868v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地运行于高风险场景中，在这些场景里，种族和民族等人口统计属性可能被明确表述，也可能通过文本线索被隐含暗示。然而，现有研究主要记录结果层面的差异，对这些效应背后的内部机制提供的洞察有限。我们对种族和民族线索在大语言模型内部如何被表征和运用开展了一项机制研究。利用两个公开可用的数据集（涵盖毒性相关生成任务和临床叙事理解任务），我们通过结合探测、神经元级归因和针对性干预的可复现可解释性流水线，分析了三个开源模型。我们发现，对人口统计线索的敏感性分布于模型的多个内部单元之中，且在不同模型之间存在显著差异。这些单元往往与相互纠缠的语义面向保持一致，包括明确的群体标签、地理……

arXiv:2601.12868v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in high-stakes settings where demographic attributes such as race and ethnicity may be explicitly stated or implicitly suggested through textual cues. However, existing studies primarily document outcome-level disparities, offering limited insight into internal mechanisms underlying these effects. We present a mechanistic study of how race and ethnicity cues are represented and operationalized within LLMs. Using two publicly available datasets spanning toxicity-related generation and clinical narrative understanding tasks, we analyze three open-source models with a reproducible interpretability pipeline combining probing, neuron-level attribution, and targeted intervention. We find that sensitivity to demographic cues is distributed across internal units and varies substantially across models. These units often align with entangled semantic facets, including explicit group labels, geo

item.title: 提出X-FED框架，通过冲突感知的跨客户端联邦退出蒸馏方法，同时解决个性化联邦学习中的客户端异构性与提前退出网络中的深度干扰两大冲突，实现精度与效率可自适应调节的个性化联邦学习。
item.description:
提前退出网络的联邦个性化

Federated Personalization of Early-Exit Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10015

提出X-FED框架，通过冲突感知的跨客户端联邦退出蒸馏方法，同时解决个性化联邦学习中的客户端异构性与提前退出网络中的深度干扰两大冲突，实现精度与效率可自适应调节的个性化联邦学习。

个性化联邦学习（PFL）擅长为客户端定制专属模型，这在去中心化和异构数据环境中尤为关键，然而现有方法产生的是静态模型，其精度与效率之间存在固定的权衡。这种固有的静态特性限制了模型适应随上下文和资源可用性而变化的推理需求的能力，为实际部署带来了挑战。提前退出网络（EENs）通过中间分类器实现自适应推理，为此提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，将EENs整合到PFL中会引入两个相互交织的冲突：客户端之间的异构性冲突，以及由退出目标相互冲突引起的深度干扰。先前的研究未能同时解决这两个冲突，导致性能欠佳。本文提出X-FED，一种新颖的冲突感知跨客户端联邦退出蒸馏框架。

arXiv:2601.10015v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) excels at tailoring client-specific models, which is particularly critical for decentralized and heterogeneous data environments, yet existing methods produce static models with a fixed tradeoff between accuracy and efficiency. This inherent static nature limits their ability to adapt to inference demands that vary with context and resource availability, posing a challenge for real-world deployment. Early-exit networks (EENs), which enable adaptive inference via intermediate classifiers, offer a promising solution. However, integrating EENs into PFL introduces two intertwined conflicts: client-wise heterogeneity across clients and depth-wise interference arising from conflicting exit objectives. Prior studies fail to resolve both conflicts simultaneously, leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose X-FED, a novel Conflict-Aware Cross-Client Federated Exit Distillation framework t

item.title: 本文提出X-Coder模型系列，完全基于合成的任务、验证过的解决方案和测试用例（不使用任何真实世界数据）完成从SFT到RL的完整训练，并通过双重验证策略提升奖励信号可靠性，其中X-Coder-14B在LiveCodeBench v5上达到67.5%的成绩，超越基础模型40多分。
item.description:
X-Coder：利用合成任务、解决方案和测试用例推进竞赛编程

X-Coder: Advancing Competitive Programming with Synthetic Tasks, Solutions, and Tests

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06953

本文提出X-Coder模型系列，完全基于合成的任务、验证过的解决方案和测试用例（不使用任何真实世界数据）完成从SFT到RL的完整训练，并通过双重验证策略提升奖励信号可靠性，其中X-Coder-14B在LiveCodeBench v5上达到67.5%的成绩，超越基础模型40多分。

竞赛编程对代码大语言模型（LLM）而言仍然具有挑战性。尽管近期取得了一些进展，许多训练流程仍然依赖稀缺的真实世界数据，这引发了对可扩展性以及近重复基准数据污染的担忧。在本文中，我们研究了合成的训练数据能否支持竞赛编程从SFT到RL的完整训练周期：在后训练过程中不直接使用任何真实世界的任务、解决方案或测试用例。为此，我们合成了任务、经过验证的解决方案以及可靠的测试用例，这些测试用例可作为强化学习的奖励信号。为了提高奖励信号的可靠性，我们引入了一种双重验证策略，以减少所选解决方案和测试输出中的噪声。利用这些高质量数据，我们训练了X-Coder模型系列。X-Coder-14B在LiveCodeBench v5上取得了67.5%的avg@8成绩，在v6上取得了63.4%，比其基础模型高出40多分。进一步的分析提供了实用的见解……

arXiv:2601.06953v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Competitive programming remains challenging for code LLMs. Despite recent progress, many training pipelines still depend on scarce real-world data, raising concerns about scalability and near-duplicate benchmark contamination. In this paper, we examine whether synthetic training artifacts can support the complete SFT-to-RL cycle for competitive programming: no real-world tasks, solutions, or test cases are directly used for post-training. To this end, we synthesize tasks, verified solutions, and reliable test cases that serve as reward signals for reinforcement learning. To improve reward reliability, we introduce a dual-verification strategy that reduces noise in both selected solutions and test outputs. Using this high-quality data, we train the X-Coder model series. X-Coder-14B achieves 67.5\% avg@8 on LiveCodeBench v5 and 63.4\% on v6, outperforming its base model by over 40 points. item.title: 提出BAFA框架，将黑盒大语言模型的公平性审计概念化为不确定性估计问题，通过维护代理模型版本空间和主动查询选择，以最多40倍更少的查询量达到目标误差阈值。
item.description:
有本事就来审计我：黑盒大语言模型的查询高效主动公平性审计

Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03087

提出BAFA框架，将黑盒大语言模型的公平性审计概念化为不确定性估计问题，通过维护代理模型版本空间和主动查询选择，以最多40倍更少的查询量达到目标误差阈值。

大语言模型（LLMs）在不同人口群体间表现出系统性偏差。审计被提出作为黑盒LLM应用的问责工具，但其依赖于资源密集型的查询访问。我们将审计概念化为对目标公平性指标的不确定性估计，并提出了BAFA（有界主动公平性审计器），用于对黑盒LLM进行查询高效的审计。BAFA维护一个与已查询得分一致的代理模型版本空间，并通过约束经验风险最小化计算公平性指标（如Δ AUC）的不确定性区间。主动查询选择能够缩小这些区间，从而降低估计误差。我们在两个标准公平性数据集案例研究上评估了BAFA：CivilComments和Bias-in-Bios，并与分层采样、功效采样及消融实验进行了比较。BAFA能够以比静态方法少达40倍的查询量达到目标误差阈值。

arXiv:2601.03087v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit systematic biases across demographic groups. Auditing is proposed as an accountability tool for black-box LLM applications, but suffers from resource-intensive query access. We conceptualise auditing as uncertainty estimation over a target fairness metric and introduce BAFA, the Bounded Active Fairness Auditor for query-efficient auditing of black-box LLMs. BAFA maintains a version space of surrogate models consistent with queried scores and computes uncertainty intervals for fairness metrics (e.g., $\Delta$ AUC) via constrained empirical risk minimisation. Active query selection narrows these intervals to reduce estimation error. We evaluate BAFA on two standard fairness dataset case studies: \textsc{CivilComments} and \textsc{Bias-in-Bios}, comparing against stratified sampling, power sampling, and ablations. BAFA achieves target error thresholds with up to 40$\times$ fewer queries than st

item.title: 该论文提出无需贝尔曼完备性假设的软拟合Q迭代方法，通过占用度重加权和温度退火，利用折扣占用度范数下的压缩性来保证离线强化学习的稳定性。
item.description:
无需贝尔曼完备性的软拟合Q迭代：占用度重加权与温度退火

Soft Fitted Q-Iteration without Bellman Completeness: Occupancy Reweighting and Temperature Annealing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23927

该论文提出无需贝尔曼完备性假设的软拟合Q迭代方法，通过占用度重加权和温度退火，利用折扣占用度范数下的压缩性来保证离线强化学习的稳定性。

拟合Q迭代（FQI）是离线强化学习中一种标准的基于回归的最优控制方法，但其在函数逼近下的稳定性通常依赖于贝尔曼完备性假设，即要求拟合类的贝尔曼映像仍保留在该函数类之内。我们在不依赖该假设的情况下，研究相对于固定参考策略的Kullback–Leibler（KL）正则化（即“软”）FQI。我们的关键洞察是：软控制（soft control）在折扣占用度范数下局部继承了策略评估的压缩性质。在软最优不动点处，软贝尔曼算子的线性化恰好就是软最优策略的贝尔曼算子，而该算子在其折扣占用度范数下是压缩的；在同一范数下进行投影可以保持这种压缩性。标准的软FQI则是在离线状态-动作分布下进行投影，因而无法保证这一性质。受此观察启发，我们提出了占用度重加权（occupancy reweighting）与温度退火方法……

arXiv:2512.23927v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fitted \(Q\)-iteration (FQI) is a standard regression-based method for optimal control in offline reinforcement learning, but its stability under function approximation often relies on Bellman completeness, which requires Bellman images of the fitted class to remain in the class. We study Kullback--Leibler (KL)-regularized, or soft, FQI relative to a fixed reference policy without this assumption. Our key insight is that soft control locally inherits the contraction of policy evaluation in a discounted-occupancy norm. At the soft-optimal fixed point, the linearization of the soft Bellman operator is exactly the Bellman operator for the soft-optimal policy, which contracts in its discounted-occupancy norm; projection in the same norm preserves this contraction. item.title: 该论文提出占用度加权FQE，通过用目标策略折扣占用度比率改变回归权重，使投影范数与目标策略动力学对齐并恢复Bellman收缩性，从而在无需Bellman完备性假设的情况下获得有限样本评估保证。
item.description:
基于占用度加权的无需Bellman完备性的拟合Q评估

Fitted Q-Evaluation without Bellman Completeness via Occupancy Weighting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23805

该论文提出占用度加权FQE，通过用目标策略折扣占用度比率改变回归权重，使投影范数与目标策略动力学对齐并恢复Bellman收缩性，从而在无需Bellman完备性假设的情况下获得有限样本评估保证。

拟合Q评估（FQE）是一种标准的基于回归的离线策略评估方法，但在分布偏移的情况下，仅有值函数可实现性并不能保证收敛，且现有分析通常需要Bellman完备性假设。我们将这种不稳定性追溯到一个几何失配问题：标准FQE在由离线分布诱导的范数下投影Bellman目标，而这不一定能保持Bellman收缩性。因此，我们研究了占用度加权FQE（occupancy-weighted FQE），该方法仅改变回归权重。通过目标策略的折扣占用度比率进行加权，可以使投影范数与目标策略的动力学对齐，从而恢复总体投影Bellman算子的收缩性。我们在使用估计占用度比率以及函数类失配的情形下推导了有限样本保证，并将有限迭代误差、统计误差、近似误差和比率估计误差分离开来。精确的占用度加权消除了对Bellman完备性的需求。

arXiv:2512.23805v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fitted \(Q\)-evaluation (FQE) is a standard regression-based method for off-policy evaluation, but under distribution shift, value-function realizability alone does not ensure convergence, and existing analyses often require Bellman completeness. We trace this instability to a geometric mismatch: standard FQE projects Bellman targets in the norm induced by the offline distribution, which need not preserve Bellman contraction. We therefore study \emph{occupancy-weighted FQE}, which changes only the regression weights. Weighting by a target-policy discounted occupancy ratio aligns the projection norm with the target-policy dynamics and restores contraction of the population projected Bellman operator. We derive finite-sample guarantees with estimated occupancy ratios and function-class misspecification, separating finite-iteration, statistical, approximation, and ratio-estimation errors. item.title: 本综述系统梳理了扩散模型在基于模拟推断（SBI）中的最新进展，涵盖训练、推断与评估的设计选择，并讨论了引导、流匹配、一致性模型等概念以及噪声调度、参数化和采样器对效率与统计精度的影响。
item.description:
基于模拟推断中的扩散模型：教程综述

Diffusion Models in Simulation-Based Inference: A Tutorial Review

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20685

本综述系统梳理了扩散模型在基于模拟推断（SBI）中的最新进展，涵盖训练、推断与评估的设计选择，并讨论了引导、流匹配、一致性模型等概念以及噪声调度、参数化和采样器对效率与统计精度的影响。

扩散模型近来已成为基于模拟推断中强大的学习工具，能够从模拟数据和真实数据中快速且准确地估计潜在参数。其基于分数的公式化为学习参数与观测之间的条件分布或联合分布提供了灵活的方式，从而为各种建模问题提供了通用的解决方案。在本教程综述中，我们综合了扩散模型在SBI领域的最新进展，涵盖训练、推断和评估的设计选择。我们重点介绍了引导、分数组合、流匹配、一致性模型和联合建模等概念所带来的机遇。此外，我们讨论了噪声调度、参数化方法和采样器如何影响效率与统计准确性。最后，我们通过涵盖不同参数维度、模拟预算和模型类型的案例研究来阐释这些概念。

arXiv:2512.20685v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion models have recently emerged as powerful learners for simulation-based inference (SBI), enabling fast and accurate estimation of latent parameters from simulated and real data. Their score-based formulation offers a flexible way to learn conditional or joint distributions over parameters and observations, thereby providing a versatile solution to various modeling problems. In this tutorial review, we synthesize recent developments on diffusion models for SBI, covering design choices for training, inference, and evaluation. We highlight opportunities created by various concepts such as guidance, score composition, flow matching, consistency models, and joint modeling. Furthermore, we discuss how efficiency and statistical accuracy are affected by noise schedules, parameterizations, and samplers. Finally, we illustrate these concepts with case studies across parameter dimensionalities, simulation budgets, and model type

item.title: 该论文提出将KV缓存管理形式化为准入、选择和驱逐三个原语组成的因果系统，并通过轻量级的写入门控KV（WG-KV）机制在token进入缓存前预测其效用，从而提前过滤冗余状态、显著降低内存占用并加速长上下文LLM推理的预填充和解码阶段。
item.description:
KV准入：学习写入什么以实现高效的长上下文LLM推理

KV Admission: Learning What to Write for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17452

该论文提出将KV缓存管理形式化为准入、选择和驱逐三个原语组成的因果系统，并通过轻量级的写入门控KV（WG-KV）机制在token进入缓存前预测其效用，从而提前过滤冗余状态、显著降低内存占用并加速长上下文LLM推理的预填充和解码阶段。

长上下文LLM推理受到二次方注意力复杂度和线性键值缓存增长的瓶颈制约。先前的方法通过事后选择或驱逐来缓解这一问题，但忽视了根本的低效之处：不加区分的token准入。在本文中，我们将KV管理形式化为一个由三个原语组成的因果系统：KV准入、选择和驱逐。我们通过写入门控KV（WG-KV）来实现KV准入，这是一种轻量级机制，能够在token进入缓存之前学习预测其效用。通过提前过滤冗余状态以维护一个紧凑的全局缓存和滑动本地缓存，WG-KV显著减少了内存使用并加速了预填充和解码阶段。我们的结果表明，学习写入什么内容是实现高效长上下文推理的一种有原则且实用的方法。代码可在 https://github.com/EMCLab-Sinica/WG-KV 获取。

arXiv:2512.17452v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the quadratic attention complexity and linear Key-Value (KV) cache growth. Prior approaches mitigate this via post-hoc selection or eviction but overlook the root inefficiency: indiscriminate token admission. In this paper, we formalize KV management as a causal system of three primitives: KV Admission, Selection, and Eviction. We instantiate KV Admission via Write-Gated KV (WG-KV), a lightweight mechanism that learns to predict token utility before cache entry. By filtering out redundant states early to maintain a compact global cache alongside a sliding local cache, WG-KV significantly reduces memory usage and accelerates both prefill and decode phases. Our results demonstrate that learning what to write is a principled and practical recipe for efficient long-context inference. Code is available at https://github.com/EMCLab-Sinica/WG-KV.

item.title: 该论文提出SpIDER，一种将LLM推理与代码库图结构探索相结合的密集检索方法，用于软件问题定位，并发布了涵盖Python、Java、JavaScript和TypeScript四种语言的图结构基准SpIDER-Bench。
item.description:
SpIDER：面向软件问题定位的空间感知密集嵌入检索

SpIDER: Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval for Software Issue Localization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.16956

该论文提出SpIDER，一种将LLM推理与代码库图结构探索相结合的密集检索方法，用于软件问题定位，并发布了涵盖Python、Java、JavaScript和TypeScript四种语言的图结构基准SpIDER-Bench。

从大型代码库中检索与用户查询、错误报告或功能请求相关的代码函数、类或文件，是基于大语言模型（LLM）的编程智能体面临的一项根本性挑战。智能体化方法通常采用BM25等稀疏方法或密集嵌入策略来识别语义相关的代码单元。虽然密集嵌入方法可以大幅超越BM25，但两者都忽略了代码库的图结构特性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SpIDER（Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval，空间感知密集嵌入检索），这是一种将基于LLM的推理与代码库图结构探索相结合的密集检索方法。我们进一步推出了SpIDER-Bench，这是一个从SWEPolyBench、SWEBench-Verified和Multi-SWE-bench中精选构建的图结构基准，涵盖Python、Java、JavaScript和TypeScript仓库。SpIDER的基于图的候选扩展机制为候选单元的纳入提供了结构性依据……

arXiv:2512.16956v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Retrieving code functions, classes or files relevant to a user query, bug report or feature request from large codebases is a fundamental challenge for Large Language Model (LLM)-based coding agents. Agentic approaches typically employ sparse methods like BM25 or dense embedding strategies to identify semantically relevant units. While dense embedding approaches can outperform BM25 by large margins, both ignore the graph-structured characteristics of the codebase. To address this, we propose SpIDER (Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval), a dense retrieval approach that integrates LLM-based reasoning with graph-based exploration of the codebase. We further introduce SpIDER-Bench, a graph-structured benchmark curated from SWEPolyBench, SWEBench-Verified and Multi-SWE-bench, spanning Python, Java, JavaScript and TypeScript repositories. SpIDER's graph-based candidate expansion attaches a structural reason for inclusion to

item.title: Kascade是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过在算法选择的少量锚点层中计算精确Top-k索引并在相邻层复用，在保持高精度的同时显著加速长上下文大语言模型推理。
item.description:
Kascade：一种用于长上下文大语言模型推理的实用稀疏注意力方法

Kascade: A Practical Sparse Attention Method for Long-Context LLM Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.16391

Kascade是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过在算法选择的少量锚点层中计算精确Top-k索引并在相邻层复用，在保持高精度的同时显著加速长上下文大语言模型推理。

注意力是长上下文大语言模型推理过程中延迟的主要来源，而这类工作负载在推理模型和RAG（检索增强生成）场景中日益流行。我们提出了Kascade，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，它利用了以下已知观察结果：1）softmax之后的注意力本质上是稀疏的；2）高权重键的身份在相邻层之间是稳定的。Kascade在少量锚点层中计算精确的Top-k索引，然后在中间的复用层中重用这些索引。锚点层通过算法选择，采用动态规划目标在开发集上最大化跨层相似度，从而能够轻松部署到不同模型上。该方法在预填充和解码两个阶段的注意力中都纳入了高效的实现约束（例如瓦片级操作）。Kascade中的Top-k选择和复用是感知注意力头的，并且我们在实验中证明这对于实现高精度至关重要。

arXiv:2512.16391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Attention is the dominant source of latency during long-context LLM inference, an increasingly popular workload with reasoning models and RAG. We propose Kascade, a training-free sparse attention method that leverages known observations such as 1) post-softmax attention is intrinsically sparse, and 2) the identity of high-weight keys is stable across nearby layers. Kascade computes exact Top-k indices in a small set of anchor layers, then reuses those indices in intermediate reuse layers. The anchor layers are selected algorithmically, via a dynamic-programming objective that maximizes cross-layer similarity over a development set, allowing easy deployment across models. The method incorporates efficient implementation constraints (e.g. tile-level operations), across both prefill and decode attention. The Top-k selection and reuse in Kascade is head-aware and we show in our experiments that this is critical for high accuracy. K

item.title: 该论文以魔方为实验领域，发现为 Transformer 引入显式世界建模（状态预测）监督能改善其内部表征，而更好的表征能在 GRPO 后训练中带来更大的性能提升，尤其是在更难的魔方状态上。
item.description:
更好的世界模型能带来更好的后训练性能

Better World Models Can Lead to Better Post-Training Performance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03400

该论文以魔方为实验领域，发现为 Transformer 引入显式世界建模（状态预测）监督能改善其内部表征，而更好的表征能在 GRPO 后训练中带来更大的性能提升，尤其是在更难的魔方状态上。

我们研究了显式世界建模目标如何影响 Transformer 的内部表征与下游能力，并以魔方作为训练领域。我们探讨三个问题：(1) 显式预训练世界模型会如何影响模型的潜在表征；(2) 世界模型的质量如何影响后训练性能；(3) 在有限的数据预算下，应如何在预训练与任务特定微调之间进行分配？我们将标准的动作预测微调与两种引入显式状态预测监督的策略进行比较：先进行状态预训练再微调，以及动作与状态的联合训练。我们在群体相对策略优化（GRPO）之后测量任务准确率。我们进一步发现，显式世界建模能带来更好的表征——体现在更高的探测准确率与更强的模型可控性上——并且更好的表征能从 GRPO 中获得更大的收益，尤其是在更难的魔方状态上。

arXiv:2512.03400v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study how explicit world-modeling objectives affect the internal representations and downstream capability of Transformers, using Rubik's Cubes as our training domain. We ask: (1) how does explicitly pretraining a world model affect a model's latent representations, (2) how does world-model quality affect post-training performance, and (3) how should a finite data budget be split between pretraining and task-specific fine-tuning? We compare standard action-prediction fine-tuning with two strategies that add explicit state-prediction supervision: state pretraining followed by fine-tuning, and joint action and state training. We measure task accuracy after Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We further find that explicit world-modeling yields better representations in terms of higher probing accuracy and steerability of the model, and that better representations yield larger gains from GRPO, especially on harder cube st

item.title: ScalePRM通过对每个推理步骤生成多次独立验证并聚合判断结果，在无需标准答案或人工标注的情况下生成合成步骤级标签来训练过程奖励模型，其性能甚至超越了使用标准答案的训练方法。
item.description:
ScalePRM：通过扩展验证计算在无需标准答案的情况下训练过程奖励模型

ScalePRM: Training Process Reward Models by Scaling Verification Compute Without Ground Truth

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03244

ScalePRM通过对每个推理步骤生成多次独立验证并聚合判断结果，在无需标准答案或人工标注的情况下生成合成步骤级标签来训练过程奖励模型，其性能甚至超越了使用标准答案的训练方法。

训练过程奖励模型（PRMs）需要步骤级别的正确性标签，这些标签通常通过昂贵的人工标注获得，或依赖于标准答案，这限制了过程级监督的扩展能力。我们提出ScalePRM，将扩展验证计算作为一种替代方案：给定一个问题和候选解答，我们对每个推理步骤生成多个独立的验证，并聚合这些判断结果，从而在无需标准答案的情况下生成合成的步骤级标签。我们探索了两种代表性的推理时扩展策略——通过自一致性进行并行扩展和通过元批评进行顺序扩展，并使用所得的合成数据训练生成式过程奖励模型。在ProcessBench（一个用于识别数学推理中错误步骤的基准测试）上，使用步骤级自一致性数据训练的过程奖励模型达到了67.5 F1，超越了使用标准答案的参考引导训练方法（66.4 F1）。

arXiv:2512.03244v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training process reward models (PRMs) requires step-level correctness labels, obtained either through expensive human annotation or by relying on ground-truth answers, limiting the ability to scale process-level supervision. We propose ScalePRM, which scales verification compute as an alternative: given a problem and a candidate solution, we generate multiple independent verifications of each reasoning step and aggregate their judgments to produce synthetic step-level labels without ground truth. We explore two representative inference-time scaling strategies, parallel scaling through self-consistency and sequential scaling through meta-critique, and train generative PRMs on the resulting synthetic data. item.title: SpecPV提出了一种自推测解码方法，通过使用部分KV状态进行快速验证并定期执行完整验证以消除累积误差，从而有效加速长上下文生成。
item.description:
SpecPV：通过部分验证改进长上下文生成的自推测解码

SpecPV: Improving Self-Speculative Decoding for Long-Context Generation via Partial Verification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02337

SpecPV提出了一种自推测解码方法，通过使用部分KV状态进行快速验证并定期执行完整验证以消除累积误差，从而有效加速长上下文生成。

代码生成、深度推理和长文档理解等任务日益增长的需求，使长上下文生成成为大语言模型（LLMs）的一项关键能力。推测解码是加速生成最直接有效的方法之一，它遵循“起草-验证”范式，即由轻量级草稿模型提出若干候选token，再由目标模型进行验证。然而，我们发现随着上下文长度的增长，验证成为主要的性能瓶颈。为了进一步加速长上下文生成中的推测解码，我们提出了SpecPV，这是一种自推测解码方法，它使用部分键值状态（KV）进行快速验证，并定期应用完整验证以消除累积误差。我们在多个长上下文基准测试和模型上验证了SpecPV，包括LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3系列。实验结果表明……

arXiv:2512.02337v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Growing demands from tasks like code generation, deep reasoning, and long-document understanding have made long-context generation a crucial capability for large language models (LLMs). Speculative decoding is one of the most direct and effective approaches for accelerating generation. It follows a draft-verify paradigm, where a lightweight draft model proposes several candidate tokens and the target model verifies them. However, we find that as the context length grows, verification becomes the dominant bottleneck. To further accelerate speculative decoding in long-context generation, we introduce SpecPV, a self-speculative decoding approach that performs fast verification using partial key-value states (KV) and periodically applies full verification to eliminate accumulated errors. item.title: 该论文揭示了由多个近似最优模型构成的罗生门集对可信机器学习的双刃剑作用：集合多样性既能通过切换到其他近似最优模型实现无需重训的反应式鲁棒性，又会因披露更多模型而加剧对训练数据的信息泄露，从而形成由多样性主导的鲁棒性-隐私权衡。
item.description:
罗生门集在可信机器学习中的双刃剑本质

The Double-Edged Nature of the Rashomon Set for Trustworthy Machine Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21799

提出了一种免训练、模型无关的TPSO模块，通过在令牌嵌入空间中引入可学习参数探索代表性不足的区域，并利用提示级语义约束防止质量下降，从而在保持语义保真度的前提下提升文本到图像扩散模型的生成多样性。

图像多样性仍然是文本到图像扩散模型面临的一个根本性挑战。低多样性的生成往往导致输出重复，增加采样冗余，并阻碍创意探索和下游应用。一个关键因素是扩散模型倾向于向学习到的分布中的强模式坍缩。现有的提升多样性的尝试（如基于转向的引导方法）通常会引入失真，从而降低图像质量。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了令牌提示嵌入空间优化，这是一个免训练且与模型无关的模块。TPSO 引入可学习参数来探索令牌嵌入空间中代表性不足的区域，减少从分布强模式反复采样的倾向。同时，提示级别的语义约束对分布偏移进行调节，在保持语义保真度的同时防止质量下降。

Existing attempts to improve diversity, such as steering-based guidance, often introduce distortions that degrade image quality. item.title: 提出DCC编译框架，以数据为中心将数据重排与计算代码优化进行联合调优，从而系统性地为多样化机器学习内核生成适配多种存内计算架构的高效代码。
item.description:
DCC：面向存内计算架构的以数据为中心的机器学习内核编译
